summary: Remove unused catalog launch wrappers for Codex and OpenCode

replay.detail: Current native delivery ledgers, replay and receipt rules are unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema change or data deletion. Existing session, inbox, catalog and runtime files stay on disk.

rules.detail: No permission, protocol admission, delivery gate, checkpoint or migration boundary changes.

compatibility.detail: Removes workspace-internal catalog-only Codex launch and OpenCode launch/adoption APIs after their supervisor caller was retired. Current explicit-path launch/adoption and native diagnostics remain.

downtime.detail: No current native launch, adoption or delivery loop changes.

manual.detail: No cleanup or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores source APIs only; persisted state is unchanged.
